whatItIs: NaturesMud Freeze Dried Avocado Powder is crafted from 100% ripe, buttery avocado pulp harvested from hill orchards in Nepal. Because fresh avocados contain healthy monounsaturated oils that turn rancid under high-heat drying, we use gentle freeze-drying (lyophilization) followed by cold milling. Every 80 GM jar contains pure whole avocado pulp with 0 dairy creamer, 0 maltodextrin, 0 sugar, and 0 preservatives.
nepaliKitchenUses: Nutrient-Dense Baby Weaning (Lito / Jaulo): Stir 1 teaspoon (5g) into warm rice jaulo, mashed potato, or banana porridge right before feeding (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).
Instant Creamy Smoothie & Lassi: Blend 1 tablespoon (10g) with milk, yogurt (dahi), and Dates Powder for a rich avocado shake even when fresh avocados are out of season.
Quick Guacamole & Toast Spread: Whisk 2 tablespoons of powder with 1.5 tablespoons of lukewarm water, lemon juice, and a pinch of Himalayan Pink Salt.
Chapati & Pancake Softener: Add 1 tablespoon to whole-wheat dough to enrich family rotis with plant-based monounsaturated fats.
whoItSuits: Designed for parents preparing calorie- and healthy-fat-rich weaning meals (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician), smoothie lovers tired of bruised or unripe market avocados, and trekkers or travelers needing shelf-stable healthy fats.
monsoonStorage: Because pure avocado powder is rich in natural fruit oils, heat and humidity can affect its freshness. Keep the jar tightly closed in the coolest cupboard of your kitchen—or in the refrigerator door during peak summer/monsoon—and always use a dry spoon.
